Definition: from G4464 and G2192; a rod- (the Latin fasces) holder, i.e. a Roman lictor (constable or executioner):--serjeant.
BiblicalUsage: When it was day the magistrates sent the serjeants to release Paul and Silas, saying, let those men go, and the serjeants feared when they heard that they were Romans.
TheologicalSignificance: I hear this as the lictor's fear is the picture of a power that discovers it has beaten a citizen.
